module: MCP tools for the player camera: change mode, orbit around a vehicle (with continuous rotation), read the camera state and place the free camera. Relies on core_camera. Module loaded by mcp_tools; each M.xxx is a tool that returns (text, isError).
notes: The continuous orbit rotation (spin) is applied in onUpdate; changing camera mode with set_camera (other than orbit), set_free_camera or spin=0 stops it.
Angles are in degrees, distance in meters. get_camera_state returns the rotation as a quaternion {x,y,z,w}.

schemas.desc: Schemas of the tools set_camera, orbit_camera, get_camera_state, set_free_camera.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame (via the mcp_tools fan-out): if a continuous orbit is active, increments the yaw by speed*dtReal (modulo 360) and applies core_camera.setRotation.

set_camera.desc: Changes player 0's camera mode by name (core_camera.setByName).

args.desc: {name: string} orbit, driver, chase, external, hood, top, dash… (required).

orbit_camera.desc: Switches to the orbit camera and sets distance, rotation or continuous rotation around a vehicle.

args.desc: {yaw?: number°, pitch?: number° (default 20), distance?: number m, spin?: number °/s (0 stops), id?: integer}

get_camera_state.desc: Camera state as JSON: mode, pos, rot (quaternion), fov (degrees).

set_free_camera.desc: Switches to the free camera and places it (position, quaternion rotation, fov) via core_camera.globalCameraFunction. The pose then persists, the free camera moves with inputs.
